#Loading in Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(readxl)
library(DHARMa)
library(corrplot)
library(sjPlot)
library(marginaleffects)
library(ggeffects)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
```

##Loading in Abundance Data

```{r}
abund.dat <- read.csv("MeanCount.NO.hyperabundants.dat.csv")
```

###Mean-Centre Scaling the Varaibles Columns 16 - 27 are the variables that we will be scaling.

```{r}
abund.dat$ReefZone <- as.factor(abund.dat$ReefZone)
abund.dat$Season <- as.factor(abund.dat$Season)
abund.dat$SeasonReefZone <- paste(abund.dat$Season, abund.dat$ReefZone, sep = " ")
abund.dat$SeasonReefZone <- as.factor(abund.dat$SeasonReefZone)
```

```{r}
abund.dat$log.iso.index <- log(abund.dat$iso.index)
abund.dat[,16:27] <- scale(abund.dat[,16:27])
```

##Abundance Analysis Per Estuary

###Port Hacking Filtering the dataset to just Port Hacking

```{r}
PH.abund.dat <- abund.dat %>% 
  filter(Site == "SY-PH")
```

Correlation Matrix

```{r}
correlation.matrix <- cor(PH.abund.dat[,16:27], method = "pearson")

corrplot(correlation.matrix, method = "number", type = "lower")
```

Our cutoff for the correlation matrix is 0.85. We will remove any variables that are correlated above this value.

Fitting the model

```{r}
PH.abund.model <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader)+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=PH.abund.dat)
```

Above model doesnt converge, removing tape reader to reduce model complexity

```{r}
PH.abund.model <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=PH.abund.dat)
```

Above model doesnt converge, removing Avg vis

```{r}
PH.abund.model <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=PH.abund.dat)
```

Above model doesnt converge, removing Year

```{r}
PH.abund.model <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=PH.abund.dat)

```

Above model doesnt converge, removiung reef id

```{r}
PH.abund.model <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                           # shape*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=PH.abund.dat)
```

AIC Stepwise Selection

```{r}
step(PH.abund.model, direction = "both")
```

Final AIC Model

```{r}
PH.abund.model.1 <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~ Season + ReefZone + TwoDArea + circle + frac +      perimeterarea.ratio + iso.index + nearest.neighbour + Rugosity +  
    Season:ReefZone + Season:TwoDArea + ReefZone:TwoDArea + Season:circle +      ReefZone:circle + Season:frac + ReefZone:frac + ReefZone:perimeterarea.ratio +  
    Season:iso.index + ReefZone:iso.index + Season:nearest.neighbour +      ReefZone:Rugosity + Season:ReefZone:TwoDArea + Season:ReefZone:circle +      Season:ReefZone:frac + offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=PH.abund.dat)
```


Checking model fit

```{r}
plot(simulateResiduals(PH.abund.model.1))

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(PH.abund.model.1)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$TwoDArea)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$circle)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$frac)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$Rugosity)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$iso.index)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$perimeterarea.ratio)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, PH.abund.dat$nearest.neighbour)

```

Residual plots seem to be fine

```{r}
Anova(PH.abund.model.1)
summary(PH.abund.model.1)
```

Post Hoc Tests

Season \* ReefZOne \* Frac

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ Season*ReefZone*frac, var = "frac")
```

Season \* ReefZOne \* circle

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ Season*ReefZone*circle, var = "circle", adjust="none")
```

Season \* ReefZOne \* TwoDArea

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ Season*ReefZone*TwoDArea, var = "TwoDArea")
```

ReefZOne \* iso.index

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ ReefZone*iso.index, var = "iso.index")
```

ReefZOne \* perimeterarea.ratio

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ReefZone*perimeterarea.ratio, var = "perimeterarea.ratio")
```

Rugosity

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ Rugosity, var = "Rugosity", adjust="none")
```

frac

```{r}
emtrends(PH.abund.model.1, eff ~ frac, var = "frac", adjust="none")
```

Season \* ReefZone emmeans

```{r}
PH.abund.emmean <- emmeans(PH.abund.model.1,pairwise ~Season*ReefZone)
PH.abund.emmean
```

###Towra Point Abundance
```{r}
abund.dat <- read.csv("MeanCount.NO.hyperabundants.dat.csv")
```

```{r}
abund.dat$ReefZone <- as.factor(abund.dat$ReefZone)
abund.dat$Season <- as.factor(abund.dat$Season)
abund.dat$SeasonReefZone <- paste(abund.dat$Season, abund.dat$ReefZone, sep = " ")
abund.dat$SeasonReefZone <- as.factor(abund.dat$SeasonReefZone)
abund.dat$log.iso.index <- log(abund.dat$iso.index)
abund.dat[,16:27] <- scale(abund.dat[,16:27])
```

```{r}
TP.abund.dat <- abund.dat %>% 
  filter(Site == "SY-TP")
```

Correlation Matrix

```{r}
correlation.matrix <- cor(TP.abund.dat[,16:27], metho = "pearson")

corrplot(correlation.matrix, method = "number", type = "lower")

```


Modelling

```{r}
TP.abund.model.1 <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~ Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                              shape*Season*ReefZone+
                          iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader)+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=TP.abund.dat)
AIC(TP.abund.model.1)
```

AIC Model
```{r}
TP.abund.model <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~ Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                              shape*Season*ReefZone+
                          iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                  offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2,
                  data=TP.abund.dat)
AIC(TP.abund.model)
```

AIC stepwise selection
```{r}
step(TP.abund.model, direction = "both")
```

AIC Model

```{r}
TP.abund.model.1 <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~ Season + ReefZone + TwoDArea + shape + iso.index +  
    circle + frac + nearest.neighbour + Season:ReefZone + Season:TwoDArea +  
    ReefZone:TwoDArea + Season:shape + ReefZone:shape + Season:iso.index +  
    ReefZone:iso.index + Season:circle + ReefZone:circle + Season:frac +  
    ReefZone:frac + Season:nearest.neighbour + ReefZone:nearest.neighbour +  
    Season:ReefZone:TwoDArea + Season:ReefZone:shape + Season:ReefZone:iso.index +  
    Season:ReefZone:frac + Season:ReefZone:nearest.neighbour +      offset(log(VideoLength)),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=TP.abund.dat)
AIC(TP.abund.model.1)
plot(simulateResiduals(TP.abund.model.1))
```

Testing to see if the model would be better with random effects included

```{r}
TP.abund.model.2 <- glmmTMB(TotalAbundance ~ Season + ReefZone + TwoDArea + shape + iso.index +  
    circle + frac + nearest.neighbour + Season:ReefZone + Season:TwoDArea +  
    ReefZone:TwoDArea + Season:shape + ReefZone:shape + Season:iso.index +  
    ReefZone:iso.index + Season:circle + ReefZone:circle + Season:frac +  
    ReefZone:frac + Season:nearest.neighbour + ReefZone:nearest.neighbour +  
    Season:ReefZone:TwoDArea + Season:ReefZone:shape + Season:ReefZone:iso.index +  
    Season:ReefZone:frac + Season:ReefZone:nearest.neighbour +      offset(log(VideoLength))+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader),
                  family=nbinom2(link="log"),
                  data=TP.abund.dat)
AIC(TP.abund.model.2)
```

```{r}
anova(TP.abund.model.1, TP.abund.model.2)
```

Model with random factors seems be better performing

Checking Model Fit

```{r}
plot(simulateResiduals(TP.abund.model.2))

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(TP.abund.model.2)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$TwoDArea)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$circle)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$frac)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$Rugosity)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$iso.index)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$perimeterarea.ratio)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$nearest.neighbour)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, TP.abund.dat$shape)
```

Above QQ plot and residuals seem fine

Summary Statistics


###Abundance Plot

```{r}
TP.abund.plot <- as.data.frame(TP.abund.emmean$emmeans)
PH.abund.plot <-  as.data.frame(PH.abund.emmean$emmeans)
CR.season.abund.plot <-  as.data.frame(CR.abund.emmean.season$emmeans)

```

Significance Codes for A

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)

multcomp::cld(PH.abund.emmean, Letters = LETTERS, alpha=0.05)
```

```{r}
# Get the CLD results
PH.cld <- multcomp::cld(PH.abund.emmean, Letters = letters, alpha = 0.05)

# Convert to dataframe and add to your plot data
PH.abund.plot <- as.data.frame(PH.cld)

# Now create the plot with significance letters
A <- ggplot(PH.abund.plot, aes(x = Season, y = emmean, fill = Season)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = trimws(.group), y = emmean + SE + 0.2), 
            size = 4, vjust = 0) +  # Add significance letters
  ylim(0,7)+
  ylab(NULL) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap("ReefZone") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9")) +
  labs(tag = "A", title = "Port Hacking") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(0.1,0,0.1,0, "cm")))
A
```

##Richness Per Estuary

###Port Hacking Richness

```{r}
PH.rich.dat <- read.csv("MeanCount.with.hyperabundants.dat.csv")
```

```{r}
PH.rich.dat <- PH.rich.dat %>% 
  filter(Site == "SY-PH")

PH.rich.dat$Site <- as.factor(PH.rich.dat$Site)
PH.rich.dat$Season <- as.factor(PH.rich.dat$Season)
PH.rich.dat$ReefZone <- as.factor(PH.rich.dat$ReefZone)
```

Correlation Matrix

```{r}
correlation.matrix <- cor(PH.rich.dat[,16:27], metho = "pearson")

corrplot(correlation.matrix, method = "number", type = "upper")

```

Modelling

```{r}
PH.rich.model <- glmmTMB(Species_Richness_Zone ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader),
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=PH.rich.dat)
```

Above model does not converge. Remvoing TapeReader

```{r}
PH.rich.model <- glmmTMB(Species_Richness_Zone ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID),
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=PH.rich.dat)
```

Above model still does not converge. Removing Avg Vis

```{r}
PH.rich.model <- glmmTMB(Species_Richness_Zone ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone,
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=PH.rich.dat)
```

Stepwise Selection

```{r}
step(PH.rich.model, direction = "both")
```

AIC Model

```{r}
PH.rich.model <- glmmTMB(Species_Richness_Zone ~ Season + ReefZone + circle + frac + perimeterarea.ratio +      nearest.neighbour + Rugosity + Season:ReefZone + Season:circle +  
    Season:frac + Season:perimeterarea.ratio + ReefZone:perimeterarea.ratio +      Season:nearest.neighbour + ReefZone:nearest.neighbour + Season:Rugosity +  
    ReefZone:Rugosity + Season:ReefZone:perimeterarea.ratio +      Season:ReefZone:nearest.neighbour + Season:ReefZone:Rugosity,
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=PH.rich.dat)
```

Checking Model Fit

```{r}
qqnorm(residuals(PH.rich.model))
scatter.smooth(residuals(PH.rich.model) ~ fitted(PH.rich.model)) # residual plot
plot(simulateResiduals(PH.rich.model))
```

Summary Statistics

```{r}
Anova(PH.rich.model)
```

```{r}
emtrends(PH.rich.model, eff ~ Season*ReefZone*Rugosity, var = "Rugosity")
```





Perimeter Area Ratio


circle

```{r}
                            TwoDArea*Season+
                            TwoDArea*ReefZone+

                            frac*ReefZone+
                          iso.index*Season+
                            iso.index*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season+
                  circle*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season+
                  Rugosity*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season+
                  perimeterarea.ratio*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season+
                    nearest.neighbour*ReefZone+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader),
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=CR.rich.dat)
```

```{r}
                            TwoDArea*Season+

                          iso.index*Season+
                            iso.index*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season+
                  circle*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season+
                  Rugosity*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season+
                  perimeterarea.ratio*ReefZone+
```

#### Port Hacking Diversity
```{r}

```

```{r}
abund.dat$ReefZone <- as.factor(abund.dat$ReefZone)
abund.dat$Season <- as.factor(abund.dat$Season)
abund.dat$SeasonReefZone <- paste(abund.dat$Season, abund.dat$ReefZone, sep = " ")
abund.dat$SeasonReefZone <- as.factor(abund.dat$SeasonReefZone)
```

```{r}
PH.div.dat <- abund.dat
```

```{r}
PH.div.dat <- PH.div.dat %>% 
  filter(Site == "SY-PH")

PH.div.dat$Site <- as.factor(PH.div.dat$Site)
PH.div.dat$Season <- as.factor(PH.div.dat$Season)
PH.div.dat$ReefZone <- as.factor(PH.div.dat$ReefZone)
```

Correlation Matrix

```{r}
correlation.matrix <- cor(PH.div.dat[,16:27], method = "pearson")

corrplot(correlation.matrix, method = "number", type = "upper")

```

Modelling the data

```{r}
PH.div.model <- glmmTMB(ShannonsH ~Season*ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season*ReefZone+
                         #shape*Season*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season*ReefZone+
                    frac*Season*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season*ReefZone+
                    iso.index*Season*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season*ReefZone,
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=PH.div.dat)
```

Checking Model Fit

```{r}
plot(simulateResiduals(PH.div.model))
```

Distribution family selected correctly, running AIC stepwise selection

```{r}
step(PH.div.model, direction = "both")
```

AIC Selected Model

```{r}
PH.div.model.1 <- glmmTMB(ShannonsH ~ Season + ReefZone + circle + frac + iso.index + Rugosity +      Season:ReefZone + ReefZone:circle + Season:frac + Season:iso.index +  
    ReefZone:iso.index + Season:Rugosity + ReefZone:Rugosity +      Season:ReefZone:iso.index,
                  family= gaussian(),
                  data=PH.div.dat)
```

Checking if the model would be better with random effects included

```{r}
PH.div.model.2 <- glmmTMB(ShannonsH ~ Season + ReefZone + circle + frac + iso.index + Rugosity +      Season:ReefZone + ReefZone:circle + Season:frac + Season:iso.index +  
    ReefZone:iso.index + Season:Rugosity + ReefZone:Rugosity +      Season:ReefZone:iso.index+
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader),
                  family= gaussian(),
                  data=PH.div.dat)
```

```{r}
PH.div.model.2 <- glmmTMB(ShannonsH ~ Season + ReefZone + circle + frac + iso.index + Rugosity +      Season:ReefZone + ReefZone:circle + Season:frac + Season:iso.index +  
    ReefZone:iso.index + Season:Rugosity + ReefZone:Rugosity +      Season:ReefZone:iso.index+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader),
                  family= gaussian(),
                  data=PH.div.dat)
```

Modelling

```{r}
CR.div.model <- glmmTMB(ShannonsH~ Season+ReefZone+
                            TwoDArea*Season+
                            TwoDArea*ReefZone+
                            frac*Season+
                            frac*ReefZone+
                          iso.index*Season+
                            iso.index*ReefZone+
                  circle*Season+
                  circle*ReefZone+
                    Rugosity*Season+
                  Rugosity*ReefZone+
                    perimeterarea.ratio*Season+
                  perimeterarea.ratio*ReefZone+
                    nearest.neighbour*Season+
                    nearest.neighbour*ReefZone,
                  family=gaussian(),
                  data=CR.div.dat)
```

```{r}
step(CR.div.model, direction = "both")
```

```{r}
                  family= gaussian(),
                  data=CR.div.dat)
```

```{r}
                    (1|AvgVis)+
                    (1|Year)+
                    (1|ReefID)+
                    (1|TapeReader),
                  family= gaussian(),
                  data=CR.div.dat)
```

```{r}

my_cols <- c("#440154FF", "#21908CFF", "#B63679FF")  # PH, TP, CR

p_ph_2d <- plot(test_ph_2d, show_data = FALSE, show_title = FALSE, colors = my_cols[1]) +
```

```{r}
PH.abund.dat$Site <- "Port Hacking"

# Bind raw data together
raw.dat.shape <- rbind(
  PH.abund.dat %>% dplyr::select(Site, SeasonReefZone, shape, TotalAbundance),
  TP.abund.dat %>% dplyr::select(Site, SeasonReefZone, shape, TotalAbundance),
  CR.abund.dat %>% dplyr::select(Site, SeasonReefZone, shape, TotalAbundance)
)

# --- Port Hacking (raw points only - shape not in model) ---

                     aes(x = shape, y = TotalAbundance)) +
  geom_point(colour = my_cols[1], alpha = 0.6,
             size = 0.75) +
```

```{r}
  attr(div_cr_iso_filtered, "rawdata")$group == "Winter", ]

# Relabel filtered object group to site name
div_cr_iso_filtered$group <- "Crookhaven River"
attr(div_cr_iso_filtered, "rawdata")$group <- factor(
  attr(div_cr_iso_filtered, "rawdata")$group,
  labels = "Crookhaven River"
)

# Relabel full object group to site name (for raw points)
div_cr_iso$group <- "Crookhaven River"
attr(div_cr_iso, "rawdata")$group <- factor(
  attr(div_cr_iso, "rawdata")$group,
  levels = levels(attr(div_cr_iso, "rawdata")$group),
  labels = rep("Crookhaven River", length(levels(attr(div_cr_iso, "rawdata")$group)))
)

# Plot filtered line with all raw points
div_cr_iso_plot <- plot(div_cr_iso_filtered, show_data = FALSE, show_title = FALSE, colors = my_cols[3]) +
  geom_point(data = attr(div_cr_iso, "rawdata"),
             aes(x = x, y = response),
             colour = my_cols[3], alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title   = element_blank(),
     strip.text   = element_blank()
  )

# --- Stitch together ---
div.iso <- div_ph_iso_plot | div_tp_iso_plot | div_cr_iso_plot
div.iso

# --- Stitch together ---
div.iso <- div_ph_iso_plot | div_tp_iso_plot | div_cr_iso_plot
div.iso
```

#Multivariate Analysis

```{r}
library(mvabund)

#loading in species file
species <- read.csv("species.data.csv")

species <- species %>% 
  mutate(abundance = AverageMeanCount*VideoLength)
```

##Port Hacking

```{r}
PH.species <- species %>% 
  filter(Site == "SY-PH")

PH.species <- as.data.frame(PH.species)

unique(PH.species$ScientificName)

#selecting Reef ID, Season, Reef Zone, Year, ScientificName, and Abundance
PH.species <- PH.species %>% 
  select(SurveyID, ScientificName, abundance)

str(PH.species)

PH.species$abundance <- as.numeric(PH.species$abundance)

PH.species <- distinct(PH.species)

# Pivot the dataframe wider
PH.species <- PH.species %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ScientificName, values_from = abundance, values_fill = 0)

PH.multivar.dat.order <- PH.species$SurveyID

PH.species <- PH.species[,-1]

colnames(PH.species)[23] <- "Sillaginodes punctatus"

dat.mvPH <- mvabund(PH.species)
```

```{r}
PH.multivar.dat.order <- as.data.frame(PH.multivar.dat.order)
colnames(PH.multivar.dat.order) <- "SurveyID"
PH.multivar.dat.order$SurveyID <- as.factor(PH.multivar.dat.order$SurveyID)

PH.multivar.dat <- left_join(PH.multivar.dat.order, PH.abund.dat, by = "SurveyID")
```

#Heatmap Table Abundance Net Effect Table

```{r}
# Create the data frame
abundance.net.effect.dat <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Area", "Shape", "Circle", "Fractal Dimension", 
             "Isolation Index", "Rugosity", "Perimeter-area Ratio", 
             "Nearest Neighbour Distance"),
  Port_Hacking = c(0.327, NA, -0.1, -0.202, -708, -0.296, 0.307, NA),
  Towra_Point = c(-2.45, 0.863, -0.314, -3.013, 1.14, NA, NA, -1.068),
  Crookhaven = c(-1, NA, 1.595, -1, 1, 1, 1, -1.626)
)

# Reshape data to long format for ggplot2
abundance.long <- abundance.net.effect.dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Metric, 
               names_to = "Location", 
               values_to = "Value")



# Define the desired order
metric_order <- c("Area", "Shape", "Circle", "Fractal Dimension", 
                  "Isolation Index", "Rugosity", "Perimeter-area Ratio", 
                  "Nearest Neighbour Distance")


location_order <- c("Port_Hacking", "Towra_Point", "Crookhaven")

# Convert both to factors with specified levels
abundance.long <- abundance.long %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_order),
         Location = factor(Location, levels = location_order))


# Create heatmap
abundance.heatmap.plot <- ggplot(abundance.long, aes(x = Location, y = Metric)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = case_when(
    is.na(Value) ~ "NA",
    Value > 0 ~ "Increase",
    Value < 0 ~ "Decrease",
    Value == 0 ~ "No change"
  )), color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increase" = "steelblue1", 
                                "Decrease" = "darkorange1",
                                "No change" = "grey80",
                                "NA" = "grey80"),
                    name = "Direction") +
  geom_text(aes(label = case_when(
    is.na(Value) ~ "",
    Value > 0 ~ "↑",
    Value < 0 ~ "↓",
    Value == 0 ~ "—",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )), size = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(metric_order))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(title = "Net Effect of Each Reef Characteristic on Abundance Across Sites")
abundance.heatmap.plot
```

```{r}
# Create the data frame
richness.net.effect.dat <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Area", "Shape", "Circle", "Fractal Dimension", 
             "Isolation Index", "Rugosity", "Perimeter-area Ratio", 
             "Nearest Neighbour Distance"),

  Towra_Point = c("-0.014491", "12.398", "10.99", "-71.93666667", "-0.0234", "-1", NA, NA),
  Crookhaven = c(NA, NA, NA, "-24.4*", "3.775", "1", NA, NA)
)



# Reshape data to long format for ggplot2
richness.long <- richness.net.effect.dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Metric, 
               names_to = "Location", 
               values_to = "Value")



# Define the desired order

                  "Isolation Index", "Rugosity", "Perimeter-area Ratio",

# Convert both to factors with specified levels

  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_order),
         Location = factor(Location, levels = location_order))


# Create heatmap
richness.heatmap.plot <- ggplot(richness.long, aes(x = Location, y = Metric)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = case_when(
    is.na(Value) ~ "NA",
    Value > 0 ~ "Increase",
    Value < 0 ~ "Decrease",
    Value == 0 ~ "No change"
  )), color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increase" = "steelblue1", 
                                "Decrease" = "darkorange1",
                                "No change" = "grey80",
                                "NA" = "grey80"),
                    name = "Direction") +
  geom_text(aes(label = case_when(
    is.na(Value) ~ "",
    Value > 0 ~ "↑",
    Value < 0 ~ "↓",
    Value == 0 ~ "—",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )), size = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(metric_order))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(title = "Net Effect of Each Reef Characteristic on Richness Across Sites")
richness.heatmap.plot
```

Diversity Net Effect Table

```{r}
# Create the data frame (with values as characters to preserve asterisks)
diversity.net.effect.dat <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Area", "Shape", "Circle", "Fractal Dimension", 
             "Isolation Index", "Rugosity", "Perimeter-area Ratio", 
             "Nearest Neighbour Distance"),
  Port_Hacking = c(NA, NA, "-0.1261", "-1", "-145.7", "0.0165", NA, NA),
  Towra_Point = c("-1.23", "0.604", "0.162*", "-2.3*", "-0.013", NA, NA, NA),
  Crookhaven = c("0.0965", NA, "0.164*", NA, "-3.9", "-1", "0.2760933", "0.158")
)



# Reshape data to long format for ggplot2
diversity.long <- diversity.net.effect.dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Metric, 
               names_to = "Location", 
               values_to = "Value")



# Define the desired order
metric_order <- c("Area", "Shape", "Circle", "Fractal Dimension", 
                  "Isolation Index", "Rugosity", "Perimeter-area Ratio", 
                  "Nearest Neighbour Distance")


location_order <- c("Port_Hacking", "Towra_Point", "Crookhaven")

# Convert both to factors with specified levels
diversity.long <- diversity.long %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_order),
         Location = factor(Location, levels = location_order))


# Create heatmap
diversity.heatmap.plot <- ggplot(diversity.long, aes(x = Location, y = Metric)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = case_when(
    is.na(Value) ~ "NA",
    Value > 0 ~ "Increase",
    Value < 0 ~ "Decrease",
    Value == 0 ~ "No change"
  )), color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increase" = "steelblue1", 
                                "Decrease" = "darkorange1",
                                "No change" = "grey80",
                                "NA" = "grey80"),
                    name = "Direction") +
  geom_text(aes(label = case_when(
    is.na(Value) ~ "",
    Value > 0 ~ "↑",
    Value < 0 ~ "↓",
    Value == 0 ~ "—",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )), size = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(metric_order))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(title = "Net Effect of Each Reef Characteristic on Diversity Across Sites")
diversity.heatmap.plot
```
